channel.title: KPFK - The People's Game
channel.description:
The World Cup offers a unique window into contemporary humanity. With Mexico, Canada, and Donald Trump’s America hosting the tournament, this year’s event deserves serious analysis. No show covers the joy, passion, politics, economics, and on-field brilliance of the World Cup like The People’s Game.

Launched in 2010, The People’s Game returns for its fifth World Cup, hosted by Alan Minsky, Meleiza Figueroa, and Fernando Romero.

Catch special World Cup coverage every Friday at 5 PM on KPFK, June 11 through July 19. That’s The People’s Game—Pacifica Radio’s World Cup coverage—Fridays at 5 PM, right here on KPFK.
